item.title: Keith R. Mackie, 44
item.description: Keith R. Mackie, formerly of Riverhead, died March 4, 2026, at home in Mattituck. He was 44 years old.

item.title: Dense fog advisory in effect for Suffolk through Tuesday morning
item.description: A dense fog advisory is in effect for northeast and southeast Suffolk County through 11 a.m.

item.title: Salvatore Virgadaula, 88
item.description: Salvatore Virgadauila of Riverhead died March 9, 2026, at home. He was 88 years old.

item.title: OLA revises ICE public safety proposal; request to meet with Riverhead remains unanswered
item.description: Latino advocacy group says its revised public safety proposal reflects feedback from other East End municipalities, but Riverhead has not committed to discussing it.

item.title: Say farewell to East End Arts gallery space at 133 E. Main St.
item.description: East End Arts invites the community to say farewell to its gallery space at 133 E. Main Street and take part in the final art installation in the gallery before Riverhead Revitalization construction begins. The farewell event takes place at the gallery on April 11, from 4 to 7 p.m.

item.title: Two historic North Fork homes are getting new life through careful restoration
item.description: Two historic North Fork homes, one damaged by fire and one under renovation, are being restored instead of replaced.

item.title: Update: Teens missing from Timothy Hill Ranch located
item.description: Update, March 12: Riverhead police said Sykai Booker, 15, and Hodaviah Dunn, 17, have been located.

item.title: Manorville pet dealer charged with animal neglect
item.description: A Manorville pet dealer is facing 23 counts of animal neglect by failing to provide proper food and drink to confined animals in his custody.

item.title: Greenport hospital turns surplus meals into help for neighbors in need
item.description: Stony Brook Eastern Long Island Hospital was honored for a growing partnership that reduces food waste and helps feed East End residents.

item.title: Halpin sees rail, manufacturing at EPCAL, but key questions remain
item.description: Halpin says freight rail and manufacturing should shape EPCAL’s future, but litigation and unanswered questions still cloud the site’s path forward.
